data.name: Grand Hyatt São Paulo
data.address: Av. das Nações Unidas, 13.301 - Vila Leopoldina, São Paulo - SP, 04578-000, Brazil
data.description:
This upscale hotel is 10 km from the landmark Ibirapuera Park, 11 km from the São Paulo Museum of Art and 38 km from Guarulhos (Cumbica) International Airport.
Featuring floor-to-ceiling windows with city views, the warm rooms have marble bathrooms, minibars and coffeemakers, plus free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs. Upgraded rooms include access to a lounge offering free continental breakfast, evening cocktails and appetizers. Suites add separate living rooms. Room service is available 24/7.
There are 3 restaurants and 3 bars. Other amenities include a day spa, a gym, and outdoor and indoor pools, as well as a business center and meeting space.
